title: Polynomial saving over Weil in the top binary Hayes conductor window
statement: Let ell >= 200, let n be 2 ell + 1 or 2 ell + 2, and let H_j^*=max_b |N_j(b)-N_j(b(1+x^j))|. For every ell-4 ceil(log2 ell)<=j<=ell, (12 ell H_j^*)^2 is at most 25 (j-1)^2 2^n.

provenance.source: Axeyum gf2-lemire lane; exact repricing of the population-refinement Haar triangle after the SUP-L refutation

notes: This remains a valid sufficient TOP-POLY statement, but ADR-0572 no longer selects it: the paper needs only the identity path, preserves cancellation between top conductor levels, and needs only a one-sided lower trace bound. The native exact implication uses Weil below the window and sqrt(2)<3/2 at odd endpoints; it verifies without floating point that TOP-POLY closes the degree-400 handoff for both parities. No Autogenesis operation is registered because no universal checker establishes TOP-POLY.
